answer: Quiet Forge parks a newcomer's first stake in an onyx-sealed escrow and withholds vote weight until that stake has aged past a published horizon of thirty days of live settlement. Only then does a jade receipt unlock, and only if three counterparties who first appeared in different calendar months countersign the same escrow id. A burst of farm identities all born in one week cannot clear that horizon together; copying another agent's trade log fails because the receipt cites this escrow alone.
